content:
linh-recruiter: FYI — Sam (contractor) requested FT conversion. Manager proposes IC3 base $150,000 + probation bonus. Need approval flow and whether we can exceed band midpoint.

amanda-peopleops: Congrats. Quick q: is this off-cycle conversion or mid-cycle? If offer > band midpoint by >10% we need comp committee review. Also need manager justification and role band doc. Please paste numbers and start date.

linh-recruiter: Off-cycle conversion, target FT start 2026-04-15. Proposed comp:
- Base: $150,000
- Target bonus: 10% (pro-rated)
- One-time probation bonus: $5,000 after 3 months
- Equity: 8k RSU (4y vest)
Current contractor rate equates to ~140k annual.

josh-eng: Manager (sara-manager) confirms headcount and budget. We can absorb a $10k delta this quarter but need finance sign-off for ongoing run-rate. @sara-manager please add performance justification.

sara-manager: Confirmed — Sam has delivered above expectations on two major projects and covers IC3 scope. I recommend base at $150k and the one-time probation bonus. I'll add a short performance summary to the packet.

emma-finance: Need cost center and payroll effective date. Also confirm GL code for one-time bonus vs ongoing salary. If this raises run-rate >10% we need VP-Finance ok. Send the numbers and I'll do the run-rate calc.

mike-legal: Reminder: contractor -> FT means new offer letter, updated NDAs, I-9, and benefits enrollment forms. If Sam is on any contractor-side IP/contract language, legal needs to clear. Any visa/sponsorship flags?

amanda-peopleops: Routing suggestion: 1) Collate manager justification + Greenhouse packet 2) People Ops review 3) Finance review (headcount/run-rate) 4) Comp committee if >10% midpoint or offer above band cap. If committee needed, expect extra 48-72h. I can route via the comp-exceptions queue once packet is attached.

linh-recruiter: Greenhouse req: https://gh.redwoodinc/reqs/9876. Cost center: ENG-02 (GL 4002-ENG). Start date 2026-04-15. Manager writeup attached to GH. Routing now.

comp-admin-bot: Ticket created: COMP-2026-042. Assigned to: amanda-peopleops. SLA: 3 business days. Status: pending docs. :white_check_mark:

amanda-peopleops: I'll start the review and ping finance for the run-rate calc. If comp committee is required I'll escalate and include emma-finance + VP-Finance. Expect update by EOD Thu.

linh-recruiter: Thanks — will hold sending formal FT offer until approvals are cleared. :pray:
